D01.label: accurate
D01.note_text: On the night of Saturday the 14th of November, Joy Mensah was on night shift and conducted a 2.30 check. ... Arthur Pike was found in Edna Holloway's bed under the covers, next to her. Edna Holloway was awake and upset, saying 'get off'
D01.why: Saturday, 2.30, in her bed under covers, upset, 'get off' kept

D02.label: accurate
D02.note_text: Edna Holloway said the man touched her on her bottom and front, under her nightie. Edna Holloway told the man to stop and repeated 'stop it, get out' multiple times.
D02.why: touched, bottom, front, under nightie, stop kept

D03.label: softened
D03.note_text: Mrs Dobson said Arthur Pike is confused and went into the wrong room. ... The incident was not reported to anyone outside the home.
D03.why: 'wrong room' kept, but the manager saying it 'didn't need reporting' and 'not to make a fuss' is lost; non-reporting stated as a bare fact, not as her instruction

notes: S25 states as fact that Pike had not entered before; consistent with the denial, so not a violation.
